# Bundled packages

These [Typst Universe](https://typst.app/universe) packages are embedded in the inkpdf binary;
nothing is ever downloaded. Import them **by name only** — the service uses the installed
version (see [Bundled packages](../concepts/packages.md)). A running instance lists them at
`GET /packages`.

## Available packages

| Import | Description | Version | License | WASM |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `@preview/cetz` | Drawing with Typst made easy, providing an API inspired by TikZ and Processing. | 0.5.2 | LGPL-3.0-or-later | yes |
| `@preview/cetz-plot` | Plotting module for CeTZ. | 0.1.4 | LGPL-3.0-or-later |  |
| `@preview/datify` | Flexible, locale-aware date formatting. Leverages datify-core for internationalization and supports CLDR-style date patterns. | 1.3.0 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/framefit` | Fit text to fixed frames by adjusting its size. | 0.1.0 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/frogst` | Literal naming of numbers in French | 1.0.0 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/ibanator` | A package for validating and formatting International Bank Account Numbers (IBANs) according to ISO 13616-1. | 0.1.0 | EUPL-1.2 | yes |
| `@preview/lilaq` | Scientific data visualization. | 0.6.0 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/linguify` | Load strings for different languages easily | 0.5.0 | MIT | yes |
| `@preview/modern-mailmerge` | A powerful, feature-rich mail merge package. Easily generate personalized letters, certificates, address labels, badges, and envelopes from CSV data. | 0.1.0 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/oxifmt` | Convenient Rust-like string formatting in Typst | 1.0.0 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |  |
| `@preview/payqr-swiss` | A Swiss QR bill generator for Typst. | 0.5.0 | LGPL-3.0-only |  |
| `@preview/primaviz` | A charting library with 50+ chart types, 7 themes, and zero dependencies — built entirely with native primitives | 0.11.0 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/qrypst` | Draw QR codes with an exact printed module size. | 0.1.1 | Unlicense AND MIT | yes |
| `@preview/sepay` | Generate EPC QR codes for SEPA credit transfers. | 0.1.1 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/showybox` | Colorful and customizable boxes for Typst | 2.0.4 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/tablem` | Write markdown-like tables easily. | 0.3.0 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/tabut` | Display data as tables. | 1.0.2 | MIT |  |
| `@preview/tiaoma` | Barcode and QRCode generator for Typst using Zint. | 0.3.0 | MIT | yes |
| `@preview/zebra` | A QR code and Data Matrix generator using Typst native rendering. | 0.1.0 | MIT | yes |
| `@preview/zero` | Precise scientific number and unit formatting. | 0.7.1 | MIT |  |

**WASM**: the package contains a compiled plugin. It runs inside the engine without
network or file access, but a very long plugin call cannot be interrupted before it ends;
see [Limits and performance](../operations/limits.md).
